text: Next: South Sudan, the world's newest country. Its 2011 split took a quarter of Sudan.
Next: Venezuela, just 5,922 km² ahead of Nigeria in UN data. Other atlases flip them.
Next: Chad and Peru, only 1,216 km² apart. That's barely bigger than Hong Kong.
Greenland (2.17M km²) is self-governing and listed apart from Denmark; alone it'd be 13th.
By land alone, China (9.33M km²) beats the US (9.15M km²), and Canada falls to 4th.
Next: Russia. Often called bigger than Pluto, it isn't: Pluto's surface is ~17.7M km².
